aggregation_availability.missing_value_contract: Undefined native values are retained as unavailable, not replaced with zero; n and missing report the actual finite-value coverage.
aggregation_availability.primary_metrics: Defined primary INSECTS and UPF comparison cells have n=3; standard deviations use ddof=1 and ddof=0 respectively.

upf_strategy_scpe_alpha_zero.interpretation: Only one finite value is present in each of these diagnostic cells. Population SD=0 for n=1 must not be described as dispersion among three finite executions.

coverage.full_source_method: All 24 trial coverage records were checked for 15 contiguous half-open source ranges covering zero through source_rows, train plus holdout sizes, zero excluded rows, offline/online partition totals and preserved tails. Complete source-normalized payloads and the source manifest were independently hash-verified.

figures.visual_review: Approved after individual inspection of all 12 final PNGs; hashes match the source manifest.

files.git_limit_note: File input sizes are measured. Git pack and push sizes have not been executed or measured by this read-only QA.

metric_semantics.average_precision: Exact noninterpolated average precision from the benchmark metric contract, with tied scores grouped; source and metric implementation hashes retained.
metric_semantics.distinction: UPF summary auc integrates the cost/error objective over alpha; quality/roc_auc measures classification discrimination. These quantities are not interchangeable.
metric_semantics.f1: F1 macro remains a separate metric from positive-class binary F1.

payloads.vector_contract: RFC 6901 pointer, exact full array length and SHA256 of sorted compact UTF-8 JSON; catalogue completeness checked against every retained payload

prediction_ledgers.upf_limitation: UPF probabilities were not persisted as prediction ledgers. No independent probability-level reconstruction is claimed. UPF quality values were checked as retained reported metrics and source-normalized payload values.
prediction_ledgers.values: Every retained INSECTS row compared to its original row; probabilities, labels, IDs and retained timing values unchanged.

scope: Read-only QA of the complete final exported package. Source reports, datasets, services, execution and repository unchanged.
